item.title: Broadway Under the Stars - Mamma Mia! — Sat Aug 22, 7:00 PM — Sonoma Valley Field of Dreams
item.description:
The global smash hit is coming to Sonoma for the very first time! Set on a sun-drenched Greek island, Mamma Mia! follows a young bride-to-be on a quest to discover the identity of her father — bringing three very unexpected guests from her mother’s past back into their lives. Fueled by ABBA’s greatest hits (including “Dancing Queen,” “Mamma Mia,” “The Winner Takes It All,” and more), this joyful tale of family, friendship, love, and second chances has captured the hearts of millions worldwide. With its large cast, explosive dance numbers, nonstop humor, and irresistible score, Mamma Mia! promises to be one of the biggest and most unforgettable productions in Transcendence history. Mamma Mia! is presented through special arrangement with Music Theatre International (MTI). All authorized performance materials are also supplied by MTI. www.mtishows.com
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: Culinary Garden Cooking Classes at Quivira Vineyards — Sun Aug 23, 12:00 AM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description: Discover your family story at our Family Search Center You will find our center in the Lakeport building in the room next to the nursery. All services provided in centers are free. You’ll enjoy: Personalized help Center guests can receive personal help from volunteers in one of more than 5,400 centers worldwide. Access to technology Centers offer complimentary access to computers, internet, and subscription family history websites. Available resources vary by location. Access to exclusive records Visitors to FamilySearch Centers get special access to images of historical records that are only available in centers. Websites available at all locations: Ancestry, My Heritage, Family Search, Find My Past, American Ancestors, Geneanet https://www.family search.org Explore videos about family history and temples

item.description: Habrá servicio de interpretación al español Join us for this free educational seminar open to all Sonoma County employers, business leaders, HR professionals, and managers. The first session of this three-part series explores the Pregnant Worker Fairness Act and practical strategies for supporting employees during pregnancy, after childbirth, and throughout the transition to parenthood. Presented by Samantha Pungprakearti, Associate, Carle, Mackie, Power & Ross LLP, the seminar combines expert employment legal reminders with discussion of innovative workplace practices that help employers attract, retain, and support talented employees through work-life balance initiatives. Participants will learn: What accommodations employers may be required to provide during pregnancy and after childbirth—and why those obligations are broader than many employers realize. item.title: Frank Lloyd Wright Civic Center Tours — Fri Aug 28, 10:30 AM — Civic Center
item.description:
Price: Adult $10, Senior/Full Time Student $5 \(Plus a $2 p er ticket service Charge Online\)
Ticket Info:
Sponsor: Marin Center
Link: http://www.marincounty.org/depts/cu
The Frank Lloyd Wright-designed Marin County Civic Center is a national- and state-designated historic landmark. Ninety minute docent-led tours of the Civic Center are offered every Wednesday and Friday at 10:30 am, leaving from the second floor Café, Room 233. item.title: Culinary Garden Cooking Classes at Quivira Vineyards — Sun Aug 30, 12:00 AM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.
